items.title: Can I Sell My Bartz v. Anthropic Class Action Settlement Claim?
items.summary: A right to payment from a class action settlement is a property right that can generally be sold. The Bartz v. Anthropic case is no exception.

items.title: Turnpage — Why were here and what we trade
items.summary: Courts are ordering compensation at a scale that would have been hard to imagine a decade ago. A single Supreme Court decision, Learning Resources v. Trump, unlocked roughly $166 billion in tariff refunds owed to U.S. importers. Crypto exchange bankruptcies are returning tens of billions of dollars to customers. Class actions against payment networks, sports leagues and AI developers are settling in the billions.
items.author: Andrew Glantz

items.title: 📚 Bartz v. Anthropic — The "interloper" lawyers appealed
items.summary: On August 18, one day before the appeal window closed, Edelson PC and Oppenheim + Zebrak — the settlement's "Publishers' Coordination Counsel" — filed a notice of appeal to the Ninth Circuit, objecting to the settlement

items.title: The Anthropic Settlement is Final, But When Will You Actually Get Paid?
items.summary: The schedule as approved — and how the August 18 notice of appeal changes it. Administrator milestones, installment dates into 2027, and what is now uncertain.

items.title: The Anthropic Settlement: A Plain-English Guide for Authors
items.summary: Who's in the class, how much each book pays and how it's split, when checks arrive, what an appeal would change, and what rights authors kept — in plain language, updated as the settlement moves.

items.title: We're following the AI copyright lawsuits, and there are dozens!
items.summary: Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, Stability, Midjourney, Suno, Udio — we're tracking every major AI copyright case. The status, the stakes, and implications for rights holders.

items.title: How Much Is the Anthropic Settlement Per Book?
items.summary: The court's estimate is ~$3,000 per work — four times the statutory minimum. What comes out before you're paid, and when the money actually arrives.

items.title: Anthropic Settlement Advances: What They Are and How They Work
items.summary: Advances convert part of a pending settlement payment into cash now. How they differ from selling a claim outright, why non-recourse is the term that matters, and where costs hide.

items.title: Missed the Anthropic Settlement Deadline? Here's What You Can Still Do
items.summary: Claims closed March 30, 2026 — but non-filing claimants are scheduled for checks August 21, and the settlement left output claims and post-2025 conduct wide open. The full map.

items.title: Concord v. Anthropic: The Music Lawsuit the $1.5 Billion Settlement Didn't End
items.summary: The music publishers' lyrics case is in deep discovery, with a motion to defeat fair use pending ahead of trial. Why the book settlement doesn't protect Anthropic here.

items.title: BMG v. Anthropic: 20,000 songs and counting
items.summary: BMG opened a second music front against Anthropic in 2026: one suit over roughly 500 identified works, another covering 20,000+ songs with a reported $3 billion-plus demand.
